raw_annotations.proposed_function: Allosteric activation of the Ccr4-Not complex leading to accelerated deadenylation of off‑target RNAs
raw_annotations.evidence: Since Puf3 with a mutated RNA-binding domain still stimulates deadenylation, allosteric activation of Ccr4-Not by the Puf3 low complexity region may contribute to this accelerated deadenylation of off-target RNAs (Figure 2—figure supplement 1D).

raw_annotations.evidence: Interactions between the low-complexity regions of Puf3/Zfs1 and non-enzymatic subunits of Ccr4-Not are critical to this process.

raw_annotations.evidence: Thus, the low-complexity region of S. pombe Puf3 and the non-enzymatic subunits of Ccr4-Not play important roles in the interaction.

raw_annotations.proposed_function: phosphorylation of low-complexity region regulates rapid mRNA decay
raw_annotations.evidence: Similarly, phosphorylation occurs throughout the lowcomplexity region of S. cerevisiae Puf3, and this stops the rapid decay of transcripts to which it is bound (Lee and Tu, 2015).
